CustomField.description: Indicates Name on the Certificate provided matches with the New Name Update requested by the Customer
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The identity document must show that the customer's requested last name is derived from last names of the married parties (e.g., the spouse's last name, a combination of both last names, or the customer's maiden name). There should be no change in the First and Middle name. Please refer to the procedural guide for acceptable exceptions or allowable variations in the customer's name.
